entityPropertySelectorJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise entity property selector identifying the value monitored for changes. Parse this string as JSON and preserve any $type metadata. Null when not configured. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/triggers/.

changeJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise change definition specifying the required change in the selected value. Parse this string as JSON and preserve any $type metadata. Null when not configured. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/triggers/.

beforeChangeFiltersJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise filters selecting entities before a change. Parse this string as JSON and preserve any $type metadata. Null when not configured. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/filters/index.html.

afterChangeFiltersJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise filters selecting entities after a change. Parse this string as JSON and preserve any $type metadata. Null when not configured. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/filters/index.html.

resultSettingsJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise result property selections, including any nested filters. Parse this string as JSON and preserve any $type metadata. Null when not configured. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/triggers/.
